roles.title: Software Engineer I
roles.summary: Building production GenAI systems for financial document processing — multi-agent orchestration, LLM extraction, and model evaluation.

workstreams.name: In A Box
workstreams.subtitle: Multi-Agent Document Verification
workstreams.problem: Loan-modification verification required staff to manually cross-check more than 50 checkpoints spread across multiple documents and enterprise systems — a slow, error-prone bottleneck.
workstreams.outcome: A deployed multi-agent workflow that cut manual processing effort by 67% and made every verification step traceable.
approach: Built a large-scale orchestration graph using LangGraph for Loan Modification workflows.
Integrated multiple enterprise document-management and backend systems to enable reliable data aggregation.
Implemented cross-verification pipelines across 5+ document types, combining classification, extraction, and validation within a unified graph.
Enabled real-time state tracking and persistence via MCP tools interacting with .NET backend services, ensuring traceability of intermediate and final outputs.

workstreams.name: PyroAI Docs
workstreams.subtitle: GenAI Document Extraction
workstreams.problem: Legacy deep-learning extraction pipelines managed only 9% accuracy on financial documents, leaving almost everything to manual keying.
workstreams.outcome: A production-grade LLM extraction system reaching 90% accuracy, enabling straight-through processing while cutting monthly infrastructure costs from $30K+ to under $10K.
approach: Migrated legacy deep-learning pipelines to LLM-driven architectures.
Engineered optimized prompt pipelines for diverse document formats and edge cases, significantly improving robustness and maintainability.
Reduced monthly cloud infrastructure costs from $30K+ to under $10K while decreasing dependency on human-in-the-loop (HITL) operations.

workstreams.name: AI Guardian
workstreams.subtitle: LLM Evaluation Framework
workstreams.problem: Production model choices were driven by anecdote — there was no systematic way to benchmark in-house models against external competitors.
workstreams.outcome: A scalable evaluation and validation framework that made model selection and regression tracking evidence-based.
approach: Led development of a scalable LLM evaluation and validation framework to benchmark production models against external competitors.
Built backend services using FastAPI, Docker, and GKE.
Enabled systematic performance tracking and model comparison across multiple dimensions using LLM-as-judge, cosine similarity, and Levenshtein distance metrics.

workstreams.name: Idea-Code
workstreams.subtitle: Autonomous Product Development Lifecycle
workstreams.problem: Turning a requirement into working software meant weeks of manual handoffs between documentation, architecture, task planning, and coding.
workstreams.outcome: An autonomous pipeline that carries a concept all the way to GitHub pull requests, generating its own planning artifacts along the way.
approach: Architected a LangGraph Deep-agent pipeline using Azure and GitHub MCP servers to automate the product development lifecycle from concept to GitHub PRs.
Orchestrated autonomous generation of BRDs, architectures, and ADO tasks.
Streamlined the transition from requirements to production code.

roles.title: Software Engineer Intern
roles.summary: Delivered the Gemini-based document extraction proof of concept that established the foundation for production adoption.
highlights: Achieved a 10x accuracy improvement over the existing baseline — the experiment that later grew into the PyroAI Docs production system.
